title: Runbook: reconcile the "two gates" sentences with the three hand-run rows in "The gate set each route runs"
description:
Filed from QCLI-464's review round 2 (opum-workflow:review-assignment attempt 2 at head 605a4b3e; envelope recorded on job-062sisk). The team lead ruled the finding should be fixed as its own task rather than reopened in QCLI-464.

QCLI-464 added the subsection "The gate set each route runs" to docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md. Three of its sentences say the local route drops TWO gates -- :454 "two of that workflow's gates are CI-only", :566-567 "release.yml runs two gates the local script does not", :719 "dropped two CI gates". That count groups by gate SCRIPT (release-provenance.mjs and check-breaking-bump.mjs), which is how AC2 of QCLI-464 words it. The same subsection's table enumerates by release.yml STEP and marks THREE rows "Not run -- run it by hand" (release-provenance --pre, check-breaking-bump --pair, release-provenance --post), and the hand-run block gives three commands. So the two counts disagree inside one document, and a reader who trusts "two" and runs only --pre plus --pair skips release-provenance --post.

The round-2 reviewer explicitly called it not an AC failure for QCLI-464 and approved; the table and hand-run block are correct. Fix direction: make the "two" sentences agree with the table -- e.g. "two gate scripts, three invocations" -- or otherwise state both counts. Do not change the table's content, which was verified against the sources.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every sentence in "The gate set each route runs" that counts the local route's uncovered gates agrees with the table and the hand-run block, which name three invocations across two scripts (e.g. "two gate scripts, three invocations").

plan: 1. Reconcile every gate-count sentence in docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md (:454, :567, :719 and the :761 narrative) to two gate scripts / three invocations, naming all three; leave the table and the hand-run block unchanged.
2. Run lore check (exit 0) -- the definition of done for a docs change.
3. Commit on docs/QCLI-491-runbook-gate-count, open the PR into dev, one review round, land with opum-control task land job-1tf64dw <pr>.
implementationNotes: Reconciled FOUR count sentences in docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md to "two gate scripts, three invocations": :454, :567, :719 (which now names all three invocations -- release-provenance --pre, check-breaking-bump --pair, release-provenance --post) and the :761 narrative (both gates -> both gate scripts). The table and the hand-run block are UNCHANGED, which the round-2 review of QCLI-464 already verified as correct. lore check exit 0 (65 files, 0 errors, 4 pre-existing agent-profile-capacity warnings).
finalSummary: Four gate-count sentences in docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md reconciled to "two gate scripts, three invocations". The subsection "The gate set each route runs" counted the local route uncovered CI gates as TWO while its own table marks THREE rows "Not run -- run it by hand" (release-provenance --pre, check-breaking-bump --pair, release-provenance --post) -- two scripts, three invocations -- so a reader trusting "two" and running only --pre and --pair silently skipped --post. Sentences at :454, :567, :719 and the :761 narrative now agree with the table; :719 names all three invocations. The table and the hand-run block are UNCHANGED, already verified against the sources by QCLI-464 round-2 review. Verified: grep shows no remaining "two gates"/"both gates" undercount, and lore check exits 0 (65 files, 0 errors, 4 pre-existing agent-profile-capacity warnings).
